integrity: No independent scientific audit is claimed. The proof is self-contained except for standard Euler-product, Archimedean, and Ramanujan-prime theorems, with the latter cited explicitly.
scientific_limitations: Only the closure and the reciprocal-square exponent are classified; pointwise attainment and other exponents are not asserted. Exact finite rational verification depends for the infinite prime tail on the unconditional fifth Ramanujan-prime theorem. Earlier unindexed coverage remains possible.
title: Connected closure of reciprocal-square bi-unitary divisor sums
